footer.description: Oikkoparishad is a non-political, non-profit voluntary social welfare organization dedicated to improving the lives of underserved communities in Bangladesh since 2024.

home.aboutDesc1: Oikkoparishad is a non-profit organization focused on uplifting underprivileged communities. Since our founding in 2024, we have been working tirelessly to provide education, healthcare, and sustainable livelihood opportunities to those who need them most.
home.aboutDesc2: Our mission is to empower individuals through community-driven programs that create lasting positive change across Bangladesh.
home.presidentQuote: "Oikkoparishad has been a beacon of hope and progress for our community since 2024. Through years of dedicated service, we have touched countless lives through education, healthcare, and empowerment initiatives. Our journey continues with renewed vigor and commitment to serve."
home.secretaryQuote: "As Secretary, I am honored to work alongside dedicated volunteers and staff who share our vision for a better tomorrow. Together, we have built schools, provided healthcare, and empowered women across Jalalabad. Our work is far from done, and I invite you to join us."
